summary: Lists combine filter parameters: `_input` (first dict), `_dicts` (dicts to merge), `list_merge` (replace by default, or append, append_rp, keep, prepend, prepend_rp), and `recursive` (default false).
questions: How do I deep-merge nested dictionaries with combine?
What happens to lists when combining dictionaries?
How do I append lists instead of replacing them when merging dicts?
What options does the combine filter take?

answer_card.title: combine filter parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (dict, required): first dictionary.
- `_dicts` (list of dicts, required): dictionaries to merge in.
- `list_merge` (default `replace`; `append`, `append_rp`, `keep`, `prepend`, `prepend_rp`): behavior when list values are encountered.
- `recursive` (default false): if true, merge nested elements recursively.

```yaml
merged: "{{ a | ansible.builtin.combine(b, recursive=true, list_merge='append') }}"
```
